notes: Arrives "a/b" read as OpStage a of Game-Turn b (chart intro p115: #/- is the OpStage, -/# the Game-Turn).
Parents taken from indentation per chart intro.
Chart printed as [4.44B] on p115.

Read twice (archive.org scan jp2 115-131; community 300 dpi Commonwealth Charts.pdf) and diffed: 1014 cells compared; the reads differ on six parents (the 7th Armoured battalions sit under the 7th Support Group at the start: 7th Motor Bde HQ, printed above them, arrives only at 2/68, and the scenario tags them 7 Spt; and 14 NZ Light AA, printed at the division HQ indent, read as assigned to the division) and on the 1st Argyll and Sutherland arrival, printed with a lower-case d, read as D.
Arrives: the sheets print Operations Stage / Game-Turn; D (deployed) is "deployed". toe_mark N means the maximum TOE for the unit's ID code.
The chart sets head this chart 4.44B (Commonwealth Organization at Arrival).

The remaining sheets (24 formations, 258 counters; Mission 6 Task 3.4) were read twice the same way: 1464 cells compared; the substantive differences were five (KDG's parent, 13 DCL's home sheet, 29th Indian Bde HQ printed at the division indent and read as under it, and the l/1 in two South African abbreviations), each resolved from the scan. The Unassigned Indian sheet's rows were second-read by hand from the scan.
